reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking reduced Co content to lower atomic size misfit and altered short-range order, which plausibly affects solid-solution strengthening and ductility in single-phase FCC alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, using XRD, APT/TEM, and mechanical testing to correlate composition, lattice distortion, SRO, and properties, but the falsification criterion is somewhat vague ('no systematic correlation') and could be made more decisive.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as it addresses a practical cost-performance trade-off and proposes a mechanistic link between composition, structure, and properties, though it does not fully resolve the broader question of deformation and failure differences across all 16 alloys.
